question: What was ordered quantity per order for the full year 2025? Use the recorded order date for the 2025 scope.

action.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS ORDER_COUNT, SUM(ITEM_QUANTITY) AS TOTAL_ORDERED_QUANTITY, SUM(ITEM_QUANTITY) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS QUANTITY_PER_ORDER FROM ZOMATO_DLR.CORE.FACT_ORDER WHERE ORDER_DATE >= '2025-01-01' AND ORDER_DATE < '2026-01-01'
action.metrics: 2025 total ordered quantity divided by order count; includes all recorded orders regardless of status

action.answer: For the full year 2025, using recorded ORDER_DATE and all orders regardless of status, average ordered quantity was 2.805393 items per order (12,230,877 ordered items across 4,359,773 orders).
